title: Gate cubic online HNF to eligible collection regimes
objective: Restrict online exact HNF state to relation regimes where it can close the proof: bounded PARI-shaped collection or an exhaustive retry with an already certified small unit; preserve exact early closure and final HNF/SNF replay while avoiding redundant online state for no-unit exhaustive collection.
validation: env SAGEJS_HYPERELLIPTIC_AUTO_RECEIPT_POLICY=off node --test --test-name-pattern=the complete cubic closure|one unsupported operation test/number-field-cubic-fmpz-closure.cjs

runs.command: env SAGEJS_HYPERELLIPTIC_AUTO_RECEIPT_POLICY=off node --test --test-name-pattern=the complete cubic closure|one unsupported operation test/number-field-cubic-fmpz-closure.cjs

handoff.summary: The exact online relation quotient now has one explicit eligibility predicate: it remains fully resident for bounded PARI-shaped efforts 3--5 and for exhaustive retries whose small-unit probe has already certified the rank-one unit, while no-unit exhaustive retries allocate only typed 1-by-1 placeholders and never enter an online update path. The independent adjacent-order matrix is likewise materialized and initialized only for the PARI permutation that consumes it. Existing 3.1.10636.1 and holdout early-close diagnostics remain exact, and a forced effort-1 x^3+9*x-55 computation retains 17 rows, returns C5, publishes no false trivial-close diagnostics, and passes independent conditional-GRH replay. A whole-tree allocation A/B established separately that cf1307be succeeds at the minimum 1 MiB but b7b95a2a and this source require exactly 2,656,608 temporary bytes for 3.1.69305231.3; that change is caused by the compiler's early checkpoint placement, not by online-HNF state, so this lane makes no 2 MiB restoration claim.
risks: LMFDB 3.1.69305231.3 still exceeds the current public 2 MiB temporary cap because the earlier fmpz checkpoint now covers the complete resource lifetime; integration must requalify the cap independently.

The complete pnpm test:native gate was not rerun in this lane. Its cubic production-closure case is known to fail at the stale 2 MiB cap, and architecture:check reaches an unrelated stale optimizer-opportunity manifest after all native architecture checks pass.
Focused native validation ran on linux-x64; cross-platform production-pack CI remains authoritative.
next_steps: Integrate with the explicit 3 MiB cubic temporary-cap requalification and its large-regulator regression.
Regenerate shared optimizer and receipt-policy artifacts, then run the complete architecture and native gates on the integrated source.
Reuse the preserved bounded online quotient for the next wide C15 support-transcript optimization.
